swaps.rationale: Guardian: Horned Wolf replaces Hobgoblin to test ally-dependent armor and physical-defense reduction while retaining Transparent Slime and Brown Slime protection. Trades Vulnerable synergy for a different defensive/debuff package.

Restorer: Pack Howler replaces Goblin Shaman to test living-ally Power scaling for the retained Power-based heals, plus coordinated party basic attacks. Trades Recovery and a heal-over-time ability for party damage and scaling.
Both Strikers: Dire Wolf replaces Pixie to test physical Bleed damage and outnumbering-dependent critical chance with the same gauntlets, trading magical area damage and critical-damage buildup.

Controller: Wood Nymph replaces Giant Bat to add Cover, a Power-scaled barrier and personal Renewal/Ward while retaining Enchanted Fairy control and Frost Imp Chill. Tests protection alongside the party's existing control.
